title: Number of visits along a walk
statement: Let $G$ be a regular multigraph of degree $D$ on a vertex type $V$. For vertices $v,u\in V$ and a finite list of edge indices, the number of visits to $v$ is defined recursively: the empty list gives zero, and for a list beginning with index $i$, count one if the neighbor of $u$ at index $i$ is $v$, then add the visits to $v$ along the remaining list starting from that neighbor.
hypotheses_covered: A regular multigraph on V of natural-number degree D
Vertices v and u in V
A finite list of indices in Fin D
